cohort: A total of 214 late preterm neonates, born between 34(0/7) and 36(6/7) weeks gestation and eligible for rooming-in, were included in the study.
finding: Early first latch-on and immediate skin-to-skin contact were significantly associated with exclusive human milk feeding in late preterm infants.
mod_finding: Non-exclusive breastfeeding was more common in women who underwent cesarean sections.
birth_weight: Less than 2500g (low birthweight was a measured exposure)
